column3: NKJV has “Come and see,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “Come and you will see.”
NKJV has “son of Jonah,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “son of John.” “Peter” is rendered by its meaning, “A Stone.”
NKJV includes “hereafter,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it. “Amen, amen” is rendered “Most assuredly.”
